overview: A momentary action button that lets the local participant leave (or, if host, end) a Zoom Video SDK session. On tap it presents a host-aware action sheet. Hosts with remote users can transfer host role via an assign-host bottom panel before leaving, or end the session for all via a confirmation dialog. Has no persistent visual state machine and does not observe SDK events.
delegateModel: This button is not a ZoomVideoSDKDelegate, does not register/remove itself from ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDKDelegate, and reads SDK state on demand (at tap time) rather than continuously syncing.

prerequisites: Zoom Video SDK initialized and registered with the toolkit via ZMUIToolKitManager.initialize(videoSDK:bundleId:) before the button is tapped.
(Optional) Set ZMUIToolkitStrings.stringsBundle to localize menu/dialog text.
Construct and use on the main thread (@MainActor).
lifecycle.initializationRequirement: Initialize the toolkit before the button is used so it can resolve the local user's host status and perform the leave/end action. With the toolkit initialized, ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDK resolves the local user, host status, and remote users.

actions: build descriptor (40x40, red bg, LeaveSession icon, secondaryLabel icon color, zero padding)
entryPoints.note: No SDK delegate registration is performed.

exitPoints.note: BottomPanelPresenter weakly references the presented panel VC.

lifecycle.delegateModel: None. The button does not observe SDK events; it reads SDK state imperatively at tap time.

states.description: Single visual state. The button does not maintain a persistent state machine; the icon is fixed (LeaveSession, red background).

leaveFlow.description: Decision tree driven by tapping the button.

leaveSessionFlagSemantics.leaveSession(false): Local user leaves; session continues for others.

apis.name: init
apis.description: Builds the button (40x40, red background, LeaveSession icon, secondaryLabel icon color, zero padding) and installs the tap callback that presents the host-aware action sheet.
sideEffects: Beyond super.init, no delegate registration is performed

apis.name: init(coder:)
apis.description: NOT SUPPORTED. Calls fatalError. Do not instantiate from Storyboard/XIB.

apis.name: setLeaveSessionIcon
apis.description: Replaces the button's icon immediately via setImage(image, for: .normal). Single visual state.

apis.name: displayActionSheetMenu
apis.description: Builds and presents the leave/end action sheet (UIAlertController .actionSheet). Adds 'End session for all' only when isHost == true. Configures iPad popover anchoring to the button and presents from UIApplication.topViewController().

parameters.name: isHost
parameters.description: Whether the local user is host; controls inclusion of the End-session item

preconditions: A presentable top view controller exists

apis.name: showAssignHostPanel
apis.description: Toggles a bottom panel via BottomPanelPresenter: dismisses if already presented, otherwise presents the assign-host participants panel.
sideEffects: Presents or dismisses a bottom panel

apis.name: createAssignHostPanel
apis.description: Builds a ZMUIToolkitParticipantsPanel (title 'Assign a host', base cell style, persistent single selection, observeSDKEvents: false, search bar). Adds a single 'Assign and Leave' primary button (initially disabled) enabled only when a participant is selected (onSelectionChanged).
sideEffects: Constructs and configures a participants panel

apis.name: assignHostAndLeave
apis.description: Resolves the selected participant to its SDK ZoomVideoSDKUser (matching getID()), calls userHelper.makeHost(user), then leaveSession(false), and dismisses the panel. Takes no action if there is no selection or the user cannot be resolved.

parameters.name: panel
parameters.description: The assign-host panel holding the current selection

callbacks.note: This button implements no SDK delegate callbacks. It interacts with the SDK imperatively at the moment of user interaction.

internalUICallbacks.name: tap callback
internalUICallbacks.description: Resolves host status and presents the action sheet.

internalUICallbacks.name: ZMUIToolkitParticipantsPanel.onSelectionChanged
internalUICallbacks.description: Enables/disables the 'Assign and Leave' button based on selection.

localizedStrings.customization: Set ZMUIToolkitStrings.stringsBundle and provide a ZMUIToolkit.strings table.

keys.default: Are you sure you want to end the session for all participants?

outcomeHandling.model: The button drives the SDK calls (leaveSession(_:), makeHost(_:)) imperatively at tap time.
outcomeHandling.initializationRequirement: Initialize the toolkit before the button is used so it can resolve the local user's host status and perform the leave/end action.
observingOutcomes: To respond to the leave/end outcome, observe SDK session events (e.g. onSessionLeave) via ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDKDelegate.add(_:).

required: Initialize the toolkit (ZMUIToolKitManager.initialize) before the button is tapped.
Construct and use the button on the main thread.
forbidden: Instantiating via init?(coder:) / Interface Builder (traps with fatalError).
notes: The button reads SDK state at tap time only; it does not observe SDK events.
Presentation uses UIApplication.topViewController(); ensure a presentable top view controller exists when tapped.
